2607.18084.title: WorldCupArena: Fine-Grained Evaluation of Language Models and Deep-Research Agents on Football Forecasting
2607.18084.paper_summary: Predicting a football match before kickoff requires more than knowing past results: a model must use changing information and make a clear prediction before the answer is available. We present WorldCupArena, a dynamic benchmark for language models and deep-research agents. The 2026 FIFA World Cup is its first evaluation, and the same process can be reused for future leagues and cups. Before each match, a model either receives a common evidence package or searches for information itself. It predicts the result and score, likely players and events, match statistics, and the outcome of the competition. After the match, these predictions are compared with the recorded result. We report result accuracy, exact-score accuracy, and a scoreline score that gives some credit when a predicted score is close but not exact, together with scores for the other prediction tasks. Across 104 matches and 13 systems, models with similar result accuracy differ more clearly on detailed predictions. Compared with betting-market and human-fan baselines, the best system shows only small gains in result and exact-score accuracy, but a clearer gain in Scoreline. New schedules can be added as they begin, allowing the benchmark to evaluate future models without using outcomes that are already known. Code, prompts, predictions, and evaluation scripts are open sourced at https://github.com/wzk1015/WorldCupArena.
2607.18084.paper_summary_zh: 預測足球比賽的結果在開球前需要的不僅僅是了解過去的結果：模型必須利用不斷變化的信息並在答案可用之前做出明確的預測。我們介紹了WorldCupArena，這是一個針對語言模型和深度研究代理的動態基準。2026年國際足總世界杯是其首次評估，未來的聯賽和杯賽可以重複使用相同的過程。在每場比賽之前，模型要麼接收一個共同的證據包，要麼自行搜索信息。它預測結果和得分、可能的球員和事件、比賽統計數據以及競賽的結果。比賽結束後，這些預測將與記錄的結果進行比較。我們報告結果準確性、精確得分準確性以及當預測得分接近但不完全準確時給予一定信用的得分線分數，還有其他預測任務的分數。在104場比賽和13個系統中，具有相似結果準確性的模型在詳細預測上有更明顯的差異。與博彩市場和人類球迷基準相比，最佳系統在結果和精確得分準確性上僅顯示出小幅提升，但在得分線上有更明顯的增長。新的賽程可以在開始時添加，允許基準在不使用已知結果的情況下評估未來模型。代碼、提示、預測和評估腳本已在 https://github.com/wzk1015/WorldCupArena 開源。
